newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France makes no change at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France makes no change at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France made no net drain or injection at a securities repurchase tender held on Thursday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Friday.
The Bank said on Tuesday that the intervention rate for today's repo tender would be 3.15 percent, down from 3.20 percent last week.
It accepted bids for 43.0 billion francs in new liquidity, the same as the 43.0 billion leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on December 27.
The Bank of France said it allocated 12.9 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 4.5 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 30.1 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 13.3 percent of this demand.
